entries.notes: All nine TypeScript declarations remain covered, expanded into direct boundary and lifecycle cases plus a differential oracle. Internal Rust retry accounting uses the checked StepAttemptCount integer newtype; floating-point input is confined to the JavaScript compatibility boundary and rejects negative, fractional, maximum, above-maximum, NaN, and infinite values without reflecting them. Counting preserves owner-scoped recovery and totalAttempts as bare starts plus the largest single owner, preventing workflow#3069 racing one-off stamps from falsely exhausting healthy steps while still bounding genuine and mixed retries. Executor and World-event adoption remain tracked under WF-RUST-098.
